format: C++/CX (Component Extensions for Runtime) header file
description: This header file defines mock data classes for a calculator application's UI, specifically for design-time data used in Visual Studio Blend and designer tools. It includes a MemorySlot class for representing memory slots and a StandardCalculatorViewModel class for providing sample calculator data during design.

classes.name: MemorySlot
classes.description: A sealed class representing a memory slot with a position and value, used for design-time data in the calculator UI.

classes.name: StandardCalculatorViewModel
classes.description: A sealed class providing mock data for the calculator's display and memory slots, intended for use in UI design and testing.

methods.name: StandardCalculatorViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock calculator data, including display values and a list of memory slots.

methods.name: OnButtonPressed
methods.description: A private method intended to handle button press events; currently empty, used for design-time behavior.
